newsitem.title: USA: Quality Dining says Q1 net disappointing.
newsitem.headline: Quality Dining says Q1 net disappointing.

text.p: Quality Dining Inc, reporting higher earnings for the first quarter ended February 16, said Thursday the performance did not meet its expectations.
Quality Dining noted lower-than-expected profits from company-owned Bruegger's Bagel Bakery stores, lower franchise revenues, and higher general expenses.
It did not specify its expectations for the quarter.
Quality Dining also said it plans to launch a program designed to speed up development of the Bruegger's Bagel Bakery concept.
It is also said it was lending $34 million to one of its affiliates to buy more than 70 franchised bakeries.
Its shares were off 3/8 at 11-1/4 Thursday afternoon.
